observations.why: Directive cadence set with forward-looking commitment; energized establishment of a new standing practice.
Aphoristic framing that alarms by equating an unrehearsed rollback with having no rollback at all — urgency-as-worry delivered through stark antithesis.

mints.name: StarkAntithesisAsUrgency
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker manufacturing urgency by collapsing a gap into an absolute — framing what is missing as equivalent to having nothing at all?
